messages:
Maya: Quick sync  pilot rollout plan for the routing/serve change. Focus: low-risk pilot, clear gates, and a safety ladder. Sketch below.
Ravi: Good. Concrete stop conditions? Need exact numbers for runbooks.
Maya: Proposing three stop gates: infra (5xx > 0.7% over 10m), perf (p99 > +600ms over baseline for 3 windows), quality (sentinel eval fail > 3%). Any trip -> engage ladder.
Ben: Ladder spelled out: 1) auto-downgrade to proto-lite, 2) pin traffic to stable, 3) ff kill, 4) region failover. Who owns each step?
Nora: Owners: Ben (runtime downgrade), SRE oncall (pin/kill), Maya (product coord), SalesOps (customer comms).
SRE-Bot: Note: auto-check configured. Will run sentinel probes every 4m. Alert if regression >3%.
Maya: Pilot UX: enable pilot via API POST /pilot/{tenant_id}/optin. Default = off for enterprise. SalesOps: need CSV bulk import.
SalesOps: Confirmed. Also request blackout windows from top accounts; prefer Fri 03:00-06:00 UTC.
Ravi: Router auto-evict example: 
```yaml
auto_evict:
  error_rate_pct: 0.7
  p99_latency_ms: 600
  windows: 3
  action_sequence: [downgrade, pin, kill, failover]
```
Integrates with router and flag service.
Ben: A/B plan: 3% variant A (proto-lite), 2% variant B (proto), 1% control, run 48h. Metric owners: Ravi (infra), Maya (quality), Ben (regressions).
Nora: Fallback behavior: if token-cost > 2x baseline for 15m => route to compat-model same region; if capacity full => multi-region with reduced max_tokens. Premium tenants bypass to dedicated path.
OpsBot: Canary created: us-west micro-canary 1% for 30m. CI: https://ci.internal/r/1955
Maya: Kill-switch policy: requires two approvers from {ProductLead, Oncall}. OpsBot enforces. No single-person kills.
SRE-Bot: Add emergency polyfill response: short canned reply with trace_id. Keeps front-end responsive on downstream timeouts.
Ben: Dev work: small endpoint for pilot opt-in (ETA 6h), flag metadata table migration, dashboard panels, canary alerts.
Maya: QA: run smoke + fuzzing for 12h pre-roll; SRE will abort if any gate trips.
Ravi: Final ask: decision on scope: roll proto-lite only vs both. SRE prefers proto-lite only for minimal surface. Product to decide by EOD.
Maya: I'll collate owners and open rollout checklist PR in infra/rollout-checklists. Ping shiproom after PR.
SalesOps: We'll send blackout list and handle pilot comms.
Maya: Thanks all. Will reconvene in 90 minutes for final signoff. :rocket:
